content: Yaubada ma a lawa
Tau a bahabaha duma, tau Keliso mitehi po ega ata ikoyakoyama. U winugonugotuhu uyahina Alugo Woiyawa e laimoineu.
Nugonugou u hinena u nugodubu a lata po u nugowiyuwa a dao tauhi u lawa mi Yudeya ubeihi.
Hilaki tauhi ubeihi ma Yaubada a paliguba u hinena ata memae po Keliso ita likahau po tauhi hita wikeliso.

Matababana tauhi mi Yudeya i winaganihi po tauta natunatuna po uyahihi a wiwasawasa i wogeleteya. A wiwogatala i dewaya tauhi mitehi po Mose a lugagayo i welehi. Tauta wotalagae numana uyahihi po Yaubada a paliwitumagana hi waya.
Tauhi googahi tohona lawahi po uyahihiyei ma Keliso i wilawa hota, tauna Yaubada ginouli atapuhi e tanitaniwagehi ta huneya amalai ma i nae po houga tuwetuwenae. Moina.
Ega Yaubada a paliwitumagana ita peu babana Isalaela lawahi atapuhi ega Yaubada a lawa.
Babana ega Abelaham natunatuna atapuhi Yaubada natunatuna. Babana Yaubada i baha Abelaham uyahina i pa, ‘Googam a palipaliwitumaganehi apo Isako tunawana uyahinei una tuhagahi.’
Geka anona naka houga magomagouna iyowai logaloga he gunigunihi naka pite logaloga hina gunihi yaka tauhi ega Yaubada natunatuna. Tamogi paliwitumagana natunatuna naka tauhi gowahi wigoogana dumahi.
Matababana geka pite paliwitumaganana i baheya i pa, ‘A houga moinana uyahina apo a gunawileu po Sela natuna olotona ina guni.’
Ma ega geka tunawana, babana Lebeka natulagalaga i gunigunihi amahi emosi tauna gogata gowana Isako.
Yohola ega logalogahi hita gunihi po dewadewa bo apapoe hita hanapugeya. Ma Yaubada a nugotuhugei ipa a winagana ina nenae ega hai bagibagi binei ma tauna a otu binei.
Geka binei ma Yaubada Lebeka i paliweleya i pa, ‘Tutuwoga apo huhumau ina pupouleya.’
Mei Yaubada a Buka i bahebaheya pite i pa, ‘Yakobo a luhogaleya ma Isowa a wihinigigiyeya.’
Geka binei ma ta baheya naka Yaubada awai e dewadewaya ega ita dumalu, bo? Eega duma.
Matababana Yaubada i baha Mose uyahina i pa,

content.text: ‘Iyai nugonugou ipa a lunugotootogogeya apo a lunugotootogeya.
Iyai nugonugou a lunugowiyuweya apo a lunugowiyuweya.’

content: Yaka ega lawa hai luhogalagei bo hai kadidilagei hita towotowolo ma Yaubada a lunugotootogogei.

Naka pitenana Yaubada a Buka i baheya Isipita hai wasawasa uyahina i pa, ‘A witowolim po tam lawa baneina babana ipa uyahimgei u manini a wogeleteya po gasi gowau una nohaya hipuli tupo atapuhi uyahihi.’
Uyahinei ma Yaubada iyai nugonugona ina lunugotootogogeya apo ina dewaya. Ma iyai nugonugona ina lipupuya yaka apo a nugotuhugei ina dewaya.
Yaubada a luuyogigai po a lunugotootogo
Ma apo uyahiu ona baha mai ona pa, ‘Inapa geka pite Yaubada a dewa yaka iyowai ma lawa uyahihi powa e tutuhagahi? Iyai emoemotana apo Yaubada a nugotuhu ega ina wotagoya?’
Ma tulau, tam iyai apo Yaubada a baha uta wimiheya? Nau apega ina towolo po tu wogona uyahina ina lubayada ina pa, ‘Iyowai po geka pite u dewau?’

Nau tu wogo tauna a dumalu emoemotana bigabigana a nugotuhugei ina wibagibagi po nau luwaga ina wogohi bigabigana upumana emosina uyahinei. Nauna emosi nugotuhu baneihi bihiyei ma gehounana ani bagibagi hota.

Heki ona nugotuhuya Yaubada emoemotana a luuyogigai ina wogeleteya po a manini lawa hina hanapugeya. Tamogi iyawoi Yaubada hi lauuyogigiyeya naka uyahihi a luuyogigai i lunugotootogogehi po i nugoyatogehi.
Babana nugonugona ipa a wiwasawasa hogohogona ina wogeleteya tauta anani lunugotootogo uyahita. Geka a wiwasawasana i hiwoga hopuneya, tauta iyawoi i wononogogeta ipa a wiwasawasana ta waya.
Matababana lawa i ototugeta naka ega mi Yudeya tunawiyai uyahiyai ma taumi gasi ega mi Yudeya uyahimi, naka geka tauta.
Amaka mei buka Hoseya u hinena i bahebaheya tauhi ega mi Yudeya ubeihi i pa,

content.text: ‘Iyawoi tauhi ega u lawa
apo a wigowahi po ana pa, “U lawa.”
Tupo awai ega ata lauhogaleya
apo a wigowaya po ana pa, “U luhogala.” ’

content: Ma

content.text: ‘Meyagai awai uyahina hi paliwelehi hi pa,
“Taumi ega a lawa,”
naka meyageina emosina uyahina apo hina wigowahi
po tauhi Yaubada lauhogalana natunatuna.’

content: Ma Isaiya mi Isalaela bihiyei ma i otu i pa,

content.text: ‘Hawena Isalaela lawana a maga mei u niha bubu magouna
tamogi luemoemota hotahi apo hina luyagohana.
Matababana apo Guyau a dumalugei lawa atapuhi ina wimihena yagiyaginehi.’

content: Amaka mei Isaiya lolowa i bahebaheya i pa,

content.text: ‘Itapa Guyau Manimaninina ega googata ita lutelehi
apo ataputa tata kokoe
po galenata mei Sodom po apo tauta mei Gomola.’

content: Paulo a lupali mi Yudeya bihiyei
Yaka ta baheya naka tauhi ega mi Yudeya ega hita ileta ipa Yaubada ina huhouna idumaluhi naka witumaganagei ma i houna idumaluhi.
Ma mi Isalaela lawahi lugagayo hi bibiheya ipa apo ina huhouna idumaluhi po ega hita tuhagaya.
Awai binei ma ega hita tuhagaya? Matababana ega witumagana uyahina hita lauwahala ma hai bagibagi uyahihi hi lauwahala. Ega yaka aebahibahi uyahina aehi hi wibahialoneya.
Mei Yaubada a Buka i bahebaheya pite i pa,

content.text: ‘Ona galeya, u Saiyoni gaima a huhouni
tauna apo lawa aehi ina bahibahihi.
Gaima baneina uyahina apo lawa hina pipeu.
Tamogi iyai ina witumaganeya yaka apega ina wihinimaya.’
